answer_1.quote: Text summarization aims to compress a long document(s) into a short and fluent form that preserves salient information.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate using standard ROUGE-1/2/L (R-1/2/L) and include a variation called R1-c that evaluates R1 on the reference summaries with entities not found in the input removed from the summary.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation of the number of factually consistent and inconsistent summaries after post-editing on the FactCC test dataset.
answer_4.guideline: annotators labeled summaries as factually consistent or inconsistent
